title: Duration parser to seconds
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag spaces being stripped or '90m' being accepted without normalising to hours. Both follow the stated grammar: spaces may separate components, and amounts are not range-limited per unit -- only the total in seconds matters, so 90m is a legitimate 5400 seconds.
